description: A slider played by the mouse that records the movement and plays it back

params.text: Plays the last recorded movement back from its start, holding the gate high until it ends

inputs.text: A rising edge plays the last recorded movement back from its start

outputs.text: The slider position, 0-10V, with the top of the strip at 10V
Carries 10V while the mouse is held on the strip and through a playback, and 0V otherwise

notes: pressing on the strip jumps the slider there and starts a new recording, dragging writes the movement into it, and releasing ends the recording

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
